purpose: Translate character competence and wellbeing into gameplay assistance without pretending the human player becomes more or less intelligent.

sensor_example.rested_expert: May briefly highlight one especially appropriate scan configuration or relevant anomaly already supported by known data.
sensor_example.fatigued_expert: Experience may preserve some assistance but with reduced frequency/clarity.

hard_rules: Assistance never reveals hidden world truth.
Assistance never fabricates contacts, signals or evidence.
Assistance does not auto-select or auto-execute the player's decision unless a separate authorized automation system explicitly owns that behavior.
The player may ignore every hint.
A hint should normally be brief and non-intrusive rather than a persistent tutorial arrow.
Competence is the primary source of professional insight; good wellbeing mainly preserves access to that competence.
